related.title: 路由器封包轉送平面
related.why: 有限 buffer、轉送表與線路成本相通
related.whyEn: Buffers, tables and wire costs transfer
related.transfer: 有限 buffer、轉送表與線路成本相通
related.transferEn: Buffers, tables and wire costs transfer
related.difference: 交換器學 MAC，路由器以最長前綴選 IP 下一跳
related.differenceEn: Switches learn MACs; routers choose IP next hops by prefix
practice: 由「框架欄位」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「交換器學 MAC，路由器以最長前綴選 IP 下一跳」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From frame fields, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Switches learn MACs; routers choose IP next hops by prefix", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

Maps identify representative vendors, standards institutions or research/open-technology references; no institutional teaching or universal implementation-site claim is made.

courses.connectionEn: Connect frame fields to isolation acceptance and audit architecture, interfaces and evidence.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 框架與學習
history.text: 官方公開資料「Open vSwitch 設計」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「框架欄位」及「FCS」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference Open vSwitch design supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with frame fields and fcs before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
